name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Georgian Cabin 2-6 Person Outdoor Sauna
description: Please note: Due to the size of the CTC88W, it will ship LTL and will not fit on a liftgate. This means you will be responsible for offloading the sauna. We recommend gathering 3-4 people to offload the sauna piece by piece or renting a forklift. Alternatively, you can add a Driver Offload service at checkout if you would like a hands-off offloading experience. Dundalk Leisurecraft Canadian Timber CTC88W Sauna The Georgian Cabin Sauna (CTC88W) is a luxurious, handcrafted sauna from Dundalk Leisurecraft’s Canadian Timber Collection. Made in Canada using sustainably sourced Eastern White Cedar, this sauna combines elegant design with premium craftsmanship. Its classic cabin shape and high-quality cedar ensure both durability and natural beauty, fitting seamlessly into cottages or homes. The 2-6 person capacity and spacious L-shaped bench layout make it ideal for family or group relaxation. Key Features Premium White Cedar Handcrafted from Eastern White Cedar, known for resistance to decay, excellent insulation, and a pleasant natural aroma. 2-Tier Benches Two-tier back-wall benches with an L-bench option for flexible installation on either the left or right side. Weather-Resistant Roof The 28-gauge steel roof, in a black matte textured finish, ensures durability and longevity in all weather conditions. Front Windows Two front windows made from 5mm bronze tempered glass provide a welcoming ambiance and enhanced light. Features: 2-6 person capacity Made in Canada 5mm bronze tempered glass 8 kW heater recommended or wood-burning option Lead Times Dundalk Leisurecraft saunas are handcrafted in Canada with sustainably sourced Canadian lumber and made to order. The current lead time is approximately 2-4 weeks to ship. 3-Year Warranty The Canadian Timber Collection by Dundalk LeisureCraft Inc. is warranted against defects in materials and workmanship under normal residential use for a period of three (3) years from the date of receipt. This warranty does not cover normal wear and tear or weather-related conditions. It also does not include regular maintenance; please refer to the assembly manual for maintenance guidelines. Misuse or negligence is not covered, and the manufacturer and associated retailers are not liable for any injury or damage caused by the product. This is a parts-only warranty, and service or labor costs are not covered. Videos Useful Links Click the links below to see more detailed info about the CTC88W sauna.
